source_snapshot.procedure: Enable EDKII injection settings, physically install an x8-bit DIMM, deploy ITP, boot Windows, log/halt, inspect mc.dimminfo(), inject rank-0 x8sddc at a socket/channel/dimm/sub_channel tuple, resume and collect evidence.

source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Install x8 bit DIMM on SUT. 3. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 4. Boot SUT into Windows. 5. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 6. Using following command >>>itp.log(""C:\Test.log"") >>>halt() >>>mc.dimminfo() >>>ei.injectMemError(socket, channel, dimm, sub_channel,rank=0, errType=""x8sddc"") >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log should record which slot has DIMM correctable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. Corresponding DIMM lightpath will not light if there is one 5. uEFI SEL Log should record which slot has a DIMM correctable error if there is one
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Memory controller 1~N (Intel x8 SDDC on Memory controller 1~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'patrol|scrub|sddc|corrected|CE_'; echo __x8_SDDC_on_Memory_controller_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

test_case.test_name: Memory controller 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Validate the platform's x8-device SDDC correction path on every approved memory controller using a confirmed x8 DIMM population, with correct slot attribution, continued operation and no front-panel or DIMM lightpath fault assertion.
required_package: Approved x8 DRAM-device DIMM PN/revision/rank and population recipe
Power-off/ESD/removal/installation procedure and known-good restoration configuration
Supported ITP/CScripts build/hash and x8sddc signature/semantics
Windows/BMC/UEFI oracle, indicator applicability and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator powers down and installs the approved x8 DIMM in the specified population under ESD controls, verifies device width and topology after boot, then an FAE configures BIOS/ITP and performs one x8sddc injection per authorized controller tuple. Evidence must distinguish x8 SDDC from generic CE, correlate the physical slot, confirm no-light behavior and restore both population and settings.
